I answered Hollis in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply is **PD-4821**.

Hollis posted it himself in #central-team on June 9, and he's a member of that channel. In the same post he said the import file labels the doors E1/E2 but their booking sheet uses 01/02. He wanted that sorted before anyone reimports, so it doesn't create duplicates. I added that reminder to my reply too.
